_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); ratings, education and information signals

pit_profile.why: S&P Global 'is a provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets, asset levels and flows into investment products, high interest rates, changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets, and volatility in the commodities markets impact our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue; the 10-K names generative AI as a risk to demand for its products (GENAI, on the watch list below)

theme_watch.reason: Live: S&P Global's own FY2023 10-K, under 'Increased availability of free or relatively inexpensive information sources may reduce demand for our products and could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.', says 'Moreover, generative artificial intelligence (“AI”) may be used in a way that significantly increases access to publicly available free or relatively inexpensive information.' and 'Public sources of free or relatively inexpensive information can reduce demand for our products and services.' It builds AI of its own: 'We have made significant investments in various AI initiatives.' The stock trades at 38.9x FY24E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (GENAI) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing generative-AI substitution of S&P Global's data, ratings or benchmarks specifically.

classification.quality_note: S&P Global 'is a provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets, asset levels and flows into investment products, high interest rates, changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets, and volatility in the commodities markets impact our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue; the 10-K names generative AI as a risk to demand for its products (GENAI, on the watch list below). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 2.80x; +105% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.26; conservative 2yr -6%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -27.2%/yr (worst year FY14-FY23, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +19.3%/yr (FY24 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +19.3%/yr (FY14-FY23 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +43.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY14-FY23); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: SPGI (retrospective, 2024-05-03) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 2.80x (78.1% downside to Bear $93 / +27.9% upside to Bull $544) | Adj composite 2.60 vs market 2.86: gap -0.26 [MODESTLY OVERVALUED] | +105% above the EPP floor $208 (19x FY24E $10.93) | Conservative 2-yr case: -6.4% total (-3.2%/yr) | At 38.9x FY24E the 15% hurdle price $562 sits above the BULL case; Financial Services revenue +16.0% in Q1 2024, forward revenues +6-8% (FY24 revenue guide); generative AI is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
